scripts.start:api: cd equipment-control-api && cross-env PORT=3000 npm run start:dev
scripts.start:front: cd frontend && cross-env PORT=3001 npm start
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n equipment-api,equipment-front -c cyan,green "npm run start:api" "npm run start:front"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../equipment-control-api && npm run build
scripts.setup: npm install && cd equipment-control-api && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
